echoParts: Christ Jesus came into the world
of whom I am the worst
verseText: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
meaning: Paul believed he was the foremost sinner, the worst sinner in the world. And he believed that Jesus could even save a sinner such as him.

recall.question: Why did Jesus come into the world?
choices: To see what earth is like

meaning.question: Paul wrote these words. What did he think about himsef?
choices: He was the worst sinner of all

application.prompt: Have you ever felt like you've done something too bad for God to forgive? Remember that Jesus came to save sinners — even Paul, who called himself the worst! You can always come to Jesus and ask for forgiveness.
